messages:
linh: heads-up — i need a mini-burst tonight 23:00 PDT for a 2h latency benchmark. ~8x A100s. who owns the standby slice for that window? can we borrow from the ukwest standby or should we request a short reserve?
kevin: tagging @ops_sam — budget/chargeback code? also what's the acceptable fallback if we can't get full A100s? :thinking_face:
ops_sam: i can own the request if we keep it short. need charge code + owner in the ticket. quota-wise ukwest has 4 spare A100 hot slots, plus 6 preemptible in the standby pool. we can do a mixed blend and pin to the same model variant.
marty: if linch (typo: linh) can tolerate slight perf jitter, use 4 hot A100 + 4 preemptible H100 fallback. H100 perf might be better in some cases — but check model quantization.
linh: okay that's fine — prefer lower variance for the 1st hour, then ok to spill to spot. will instrument latency percentiles.
jen: please open a ticket with the expected window + charge code. cc me for approval. short template: 
```
- team: inference-core
- window: 2026-03-21 23:00-01:00 PDT
- reason: latency benchmark for batching logic
- resources: 8x A100 (fallback H100 preemptible)
- charge code: 
- owner: linh
```
kevin: +1 — also add a route label so routing policy won't split across regions.
ops_sam: alloc-bot, can you run a quick availability probe for ukwest and uswest2 for that window?
alloc-bot: availability probe queued — results in ~30s. current snapshot: ukwest: 4 hot A100, 6 preemptible A100; uswest2: 2 hot A100, 0 preemptible. recommended: request a short reserve for 4 hot in ukwest then borrow 4 preemptible (ukwest) + 0 uswest2.
linh: thanks — i'll open the ticket now and put charge code when finance confirms. tagging @jen for approval when i post.
jen: noted. if finance pushes back, we'll reduce to 6 units and shorten window by 30m. otherwise green. :thumbsup:
kevin: quick CR ping — i pushed a small change to the burst autoscaler to prefer zones with prefixed label `standby:true`. can someone review? PR #4123
marty: i'll take a look in an hour.
alloc-bot: allocation request created: ticket INF-7891. owners: ops_sam, linh. status: pending-reserve.
